forget.body: This will be removed from this computer for good, along with anything Nocturne worked out from it.
forget.list.label: What will be forgotten
forget.original.hint: Tick the original to delete it too. Other memories from that note are kept.
forget.original.blocked: Other memories from that note are kept.
forget.stays.original: If the original stays, so does its transcript, but not the memories from it.
forget.stays.out: Anything you exported or printed is out of reach. Nocturne can’t delete it.
forget.error.preview: I couldn’t get the list ready. Nothing has been forgotten.
forget.error.forget: That didn’t finish. Nothing has been forgotten. Try again in a moment.
forget.refreshed: That list was out of date, so I refreshed it. Check it, then forget.
forget.nothing: There is nothing left to forget here.
forget.done.memories: {count, plural, one {# memory is} other {# memories are}} deleted.
forget.done.originalGone: {count, plural, one {The original is} other {# originals are}} deleted too.
forget.done.tail: They won’t appear in answers, pages or anywhere else.
